name: @outcrawl/model
description: The model client: satisfies AgentDeps.model and PipelineDeps.extractJson, schema-constrained on the way out so prose where JSON was promised is an error rather than an empty extraction, and every call priced into a per-session ledger. Names no model: the host injects the plan (which model per role), the rate card and the provider. Holds the key, opens exactly one kind of socket, and drives no browser.
